author: Rhetic
body:
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Ban Appeal - ParaPot [ FrostedCupcakez Permanently ≫ Banned ParaPot ≫ Hacking - Anti-Knockback, Forcefield ]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
                            Information  
  •  Account Details :
           Username - ParaPot
  •  Ban Details :      
                Staff - FrostedCupcakez 
                Time - Permanently Banned
                Reason - Hacking ≫ Anti-Knockback, Forcefield
  •  Appeal :      
                Guilty - Yes

                      I was banned about 6 months ago for hacking (anti-knockback, forcefield) and I want to appeal for my        
                unacceptable actions whilst playing on Avicus. I admit to using the hack, anti-knockback. I apologize for my    
                other appeal, which completely lied about my actions. Over the months I decided to stop hacking, but before I    
                get to plead guilty, I would like to explain the ban evasion that occurred with the account Heartless_Killer.
                Basically, the story behind the ban is very simple. I took my laptop to my friend's house, which basically
                is Heartless_Killer, and I was hacking on Avicus whilst at his house, so this resulted in his ban because
                he had purchased minecraft not too long ago. Being that we were under the same ip I can see why he was
                banned for ban evasion. So, in a way, I am asking for his appeal as well, being that he hasn't hacked or broken
                any rules in the context of this situation. If there is some problems with verifying this, me and my friend can hop
                onto the team speak channel. 

                      Lets get back to business I suppose. Previously, I have admitted to hacking so that is clear. As I said I
                basically don't hack anymore and I play legit on minecraft. I will try to abide by all the server rules and such
                that I can be trusted with playing on the server. The community is great, so I just want to play on it with my 
                spare time being that I nothing else to do after school. Most probably some or most players who feel like they 
                are incapable of competing a game they decide to look for an advantage. That is basically what I wanted to do
                back then and I suffered the consequences, which gave me time to think about actually playing. After all it
                is just a game, but the point of a game is to enjoy it just the way it was made. Finally, I just want to play on the
                server without being the player I was before. I guess I am really asking for a second opportunity to play on
                the Avicus Network. Hopefully, you guys don't get the wrong idea that I may be trying to take a last seed of
                revenge on Avicus by hacking again. If I don't get unbanned, consider unbanning Heartless_Killer, as it is my
                fault for ruining his time to experience the Avicus Network. So, I basically truly apologize for hacking because I
                understand that it ruins the player experience of other players.
  •  Main Points :   
                1. ParaPot pleads guilty for hacking (anti-knockback, forcefield) and for lying on last appeal.
          
                2. Heartless_Killer should be unbanned because ParaPot was within his house whilst hacking.

                3. ParaPot agrees to the rules and terms of the Avicus Network and will no longer use hacks.
 
                4. ParaPot hopes to receive a second chance on the Avicus Network.
      
  •  Final Statements :
                      Whoever took their time to read such a ridiculously long appeal I respect you, being that it only took me
                about 10 minutes of my time, plus another 30 minutes of formatting because it is totally messed up. Furthermore,
                thank you for going over this appeal and hopefully I get unbanned from the Avicus Network.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   Ban Appeal - ParaPot [ FrostedCupcakez Permanently ≫ Banned ParaPot ≫ Hacking - Anti-Knockback, Forcefield ]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Hope to see you soon!

Sincerely,
